params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; Write-Output '---OPENCODE---'; opencode --help 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 120; Write-Output ('OPENCODE_EXIT='+$LASTEXITCODE); Write-Output '---OLLAMA---'; ollama list 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 60; Write-Output ('OLLAMA_EXIT='+$LASTEXITCODE); Write-Output '---LOCAL LLAMA PORTS---'; Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.LocalPort -in 11434,8080,8000,1234} | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3
